title: 第13章 老狒王的礼物上一代囚徒羊皮笔记第14章 幽罗妖府叶楣复仇合作
slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: 异变突生，老狒王有些难以置信，新狒王脸上更是写满人性化懵逼。
恐惧，无声蔓延。
“轰隆！”
天空下起狂暴雨幕，豆大雨点砸在地面溅起朵朵泥花，似在为这场角逐画加油助威。
老狒王咆哮，目露滔天杀意！
虽搞不懂情况。
但既然获得这股力量，那必须手刃生死仇敌！
臂刀升腾起绯色烈焰，爆发出更加妖异的红光，它那身经百战的肌肉纤维，如同绞紧的钢索，在皮毛下隆起清晰的纹路。
新狒王尚未从震惊中回神，第一刀已是斩至。
老狒王右臂划出半月弧光，烈焰拖出猩红尾迹！
这不是普通的火焰。
而是专属于焰刀狒狒的兽魂之火，焚金裂石。
兽技，霸刀三连击！
新狒王仓促架起的骨刀当场断裂，双臂瞬间皮开肉绽。
“咔嚓！”
骨裂声被火焰爆鸣掩盖。
新狒王踉跄后退，暴虐兽瞳中终于浮现恐惧。
什么鬼！
老不死的怎会突然获得如此恐怖力量！
老狒王没有给它喘息之机，左臂刀自下而上撩起，绯焰在雨幕中撕开一道真空走廊。
第二刀比第一刀更快。
新狒王勉强侧身，烈焰仍在其胸膛犁出焦黑沟壑，腐肉焦臭，混着雨水泥腥弥漫。
它那引以为傲的年轻躯体，在老狒王焰刀面前，如同豆腐般脆弱。
新狒王的哀鸣卡在喉咙里，它看见老狒王眼中跳动的火焰，那不是胜利的喜悦。
而是绝对冷静。
第三刀降临。
老狒王双足陷地三寸，臂刀交叉成十字。
绯色火浪突然坍缩成细线，那是温度高到极致的证明。
时间似乎凝固，雨滴在刀锋前汽化的白烟尚未散尽，新狒王那颗头颅已经原地飞起。
无头尸骸重重倒落地面，彻底失去生机。
鲜血咕噜噜的从内喷涌而出…

;;
A sudden change occurred. The old baboon king was a little unbelievable, and the new baboon king's face was full of human confusion.
Fear spreads silently.
"Boom!"
A violent rain fell from the sky, and the heavy raindrops hit the ground and splashed mud flowers, as if to cheer for the competition.
The old baboon king roared, his eyes showing murderous intent!
Although I don't understand the situation.
But since you have obtained this power, you must kill your enemies of life and death with your hands!
The arm knife rose with crimson flames and erupted into an even more eerie red light. Its battle-hardened muscle fibers were like twisted steel cables, with clear lines rising under the fur.
"Ho!
! "
Before the new baboon king could recover from the shock, the first blow had already been struck.
The old baboon king's right arm drew a half-moon arc, and the flames dragged out a scarlet trail!
This is no ordinary flame.
It is the fire of the beast soul that is exclusive to the Flame Saber Baboon, burning gold and cracking stone.
Beast skills, three consecutive hits with the dominating sword!
The bone knife that the new baboon king had hastily set up broke on the spot, and his arms were instantly torn apart.
"Crack!"
The sound of cracking bones was masked by the explosion of flames.
The new baboon king staggered back, and fear finally appeared in the eyes of the violent beast.
What the hell!
How could an old immortal suddenly gain such terrifying power!
The old baboon king didn't give it a chance to breathe. He raised the knife in his left arm from bottom to top, and Feiyan tore open a vacuum corridor in the rain.
The second cut is faster than the first cut.
The new baboon king reluctantly turned sideways, and the flames were still plowing black ravines on his chest. The smell of rotten flesh and cement mixed with rain filled the air.
Its proud young body was as fragile as tofu in front of the old baboon king's flame knife.
"Woo..."
The new baboon king's whine was stuck in his throat, and he saw the flames dancing in the old baboon king's eyes. It was not the joy of victory.
But absolute calmness.
The third knife comes.
The old baboon king's feet were three inches into the ground, and his arm knives were crossed into a cross.
"Whoosh!"
The crimson fire wave suddenly collapsed into a thin line, which was proof that the temperature was extremely high.
Time seemed to freeze, and the white smoke vaporized by the raindrops in front of the blade had not yet dissipated, and the head of the new baboon king had already flown up on the spot.
"Crack!"
The headless corpse fell heavily to the ground, completely lifeless.
Blood gurgled out from inside...
